are_you_ok.title: Denver health specialists warn of extreme heat risks for people and pets
are_you_ok.summary: A week-long heat siege on the Front Range: health specialists warned of extreme risk for people and pets midweek (7/25), then Denver broke its hottest-day record in 8 years Sunday (7/27) and posted its warmest night in 145 years by Monday (7/28) — the defining wellness concern of the week.
are_you_ok.description: With continued high temperatures across Colorado, it's important to recognize the symptoms of heat related illness. Health experts are sharing tips to protect yourself and your pets this weekend.

thread.title: Sunday was Denver's hottest day in more than 8 years
thread.summary: Record heat day, acute weather event.
thread.description: Denver experiences record-breaking heat as temperatures reach 103 degrees, the highest in over eight years.

thread.title: Denver just had its warmest night in 145 years
thread.summary: Record heat/warmest night affects broad metro population; a discrete heat event people would check in about.
thread.description: Denver experienced its warmest official overnight low in 145 years due to cloud cover trapping heat after a record-breaking high of 103 degrees.

are_you_ok.title: Friends rally for woman detained by ICE at Denver airport
are_you_ok.summary: A woman detained by ICE at Denver airport as she boarded a flight (7/23-7/24), with friends rallying in support — an enforcement action that hit close for anyone with immigrant friends or family here.
are_you_ok.description: A friend and former employer of a woman detained by federal agents at Denver International Airport has been advocating for her release from detention.
